question: Can the already verified T1-B channels be shown with readable separate titles and fully visible held markers?
decision: Replace only the initial T1-B figure layout after visual QA, preserving all numerical outputs and original figures for review.
strongest_rival: Crowded or clipped labels/held markers obscuring source completeness and unit limits.
discriminator: Use only frozen source/summary/vector tables; inspect corrected PNG and PDF renders and verify unchanged source-table hashes.
exposure_record: T0, T1-A and all newly executed T1-B results and figures are exposed. Arithmetic verification passed 17,841 checks before this presentation-only freeze; this is no confirmatory analysis.
biological_unit: Deposited Hamanaka fibroblast source sample strings: four supplied suffix observations per condition, except Figure 4F three. Biological donor/preparation/well identity, independence and pairing remain unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Multiple isotope channels and metabolites repeat each sample label. Source workbook and article are one evidence lineage. Matching suffixes are not pairs; no donor population inference or cross-medium pooled effect.
population_and_selection: Exactly the same R1 15 fraction blocks and R2 14 area/13 percentage blocks; no new source cells or outcomes.
contrast: Per-isotope/condition unweighted source means and observed ranges; descriptive TGF-beta minus UT only when both full supplied-n channel summaries qualify. Percentage differences use percentage points; areas retain native source units. No pairing or cross-medium/metabolite pooling.
endpoint: The same stored dots, full-n means and observed ranges, and vector/missingness annotations; no numerical estimation.
methods: Plot frozen CSV values and stored summary endpoints only. Wrap/split titles, pad x limits, separate panel spacing and move held-count annotations above axes. No workbook access, statistical arithmetic, rescaling or source/QC edits.
missingness_and_exclusions: Reuse every stored held status, original sample count and source-map exclusion. Plot held markers distinctly from numeric zero.
multiplicity: Not applicable: no biological hypothesis tests, significance selection or population confidence intervals.
precision_basis: Observed ranges describe supplied source labels, not population uncertainty or power. Fixed vector diagnostic tolerance is unchanged from T1-A and unrelated to biological margins; no precision inferred from decimal length or tuning to outcomes. Actual independent-unit variance/margins/sample size remain unknown.
interpretation_limit: Exposed shared-source description, not validated normalized composition, independent biological replication, calibrated concentration, exact unspecified abundance/error-bar replay, source ARG1 effect, collagen incorporation/transfer, flux, necessity or mature repair. All original T1-A vector/summary holds remain unchanged. Native B1 nutrient key, collagen/Lee values and original spatial/human/X3-X5 holds persist.
stop_rule: Generate three layout-corrected figures, visually inspect PNG/PDF, retain original figures and tables, and return T1-B for review.
amendment_reason: Visual QA of successful T1-B runs found crowded R2 titles and last-channel held marks; this version supersedes only presentation of all three R1/R2 figures. Original v1 figures, contracts, receipts, tables and 17,841 independent numerical checks are retained.
